display_name: 遮挡先验训练损失精简 GPU 测速
description: 固定真实源先验权重与同一合成输入，比较原损失及省略未使用插值的损失、梯度和耗时。

data.dataset: synthetic Gaussian IQ, not project data
data.representation: one synthetic batch of 32 IQ windows and masks

roles.synthetic: generated input only; no source or target IQ

permissions.claim_scope: Local paired microbenchmark of loss and output gradient, no full model performance or target identity result

checkpoint.initialization: Fixed final source-only masked IQ prior, commit acdfd17ae205fa5e04b32a5ecdd5eea5d7bb21d4
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Source-only parent training and exact checkpoint commit

expected_artifacts: result.json: 20 paired loss/gradient timings, equality, device

metric_names: loss and output gradient bitwise equality
dimensions: four warmups and 20 alternating paired timings

rows.method: Original masked prior loss vs identical operations omitting unused linear interpolation
rows.purpose: Measure local training component speed and exact loss/output-gradient parity
rows.seed_notes: Fixed real source prior, fixed synthetic input and mask
expected_artifacts: result.json: 20 paired loss/gradient timings, equality, device

notes: Actual frozen source-only masked prior checkpoint, generated synthetic input only; no F, TX, V or target.
Alternate order, synchronize GPU, exclude initialization, loading and transfers.
No model updates; microbenchmark is neither whole-training timing nor test-output equivalence.
No changes to currently running remote experiments.
